source:
@@U02707@@
Pressing round to seek your favors, sir! Help me, I beg of you. A remedy! I have a frozen foot that prevents me from walking or dancing— even from curtsying properly.

@@U02709@@
May I place my foot on yours?

@@U02711@@
As lovers do, do you mean?

@@U02713@@
When I do it, child, there’s a higher significance. Homeopathy will do the trick. Foot heals foot, and so with other parts of the body. Come here! 忧愁ful! You needn't return it!

@@U02715@@
(Shrieking.)

@@U02716@@
Ow! That hurts! It’s like my foot’s on fire! That was some hard tread. Like a horse’s hoof.

@@U02718@@
Yes, but you're cured, you see. Now you can dance all you like— and play footsies with your lover under the table.

@@U02720@@
(Pressing forward.)

@@U02721@@
Let me through! O the pain, the pain! The rage that burns in my heart! Only yesterday he doted on me; now he’s babbling with er and turned his back on me!
translation:
@@U02707@@
先生，正在四处寻求您的帮助！帮帮我吧，我求求你了。补救措施！我的脚冻住了，无法走路或跳舞，甚至无法正确行屈膝礼。

@@U02709@@
我可以把我的脚放在你的脚上吗？

@@U02711@@
就像恋人一样，你的意思是？

@@U02713@@
孩子，当我这么做的时候，就有了更高的意义。顺势疗法会起作用。足疗治愈足部，身体其他部位也是如此。过来！ 愁愁满面！你不必归还它！

@@U02715@@
（尖叫。）

@@U02716@@
噢！好痛啊！我的脚就像着火了！那是一段艰难的脚步。就像马蹄一样。

@@U02718@@
是的，但你已经痊愈了，你看。现在您可以随心所欲地跳舞，并与您的爱人在桌子底下踢脚。

@@U02720@@
（向前压。）

@@U02721@@
让我过去吧！噢，痛苦，痛苦！心中的怒火在燃烧！昨天他还宠着我；现在他在胡言乱语，然后背对着我！
